data.body: Negative probe outcome (2026-07-28): revision 8ac3d3c1218c6a108fd6772f5b3686a883ad2415 received LLM-Review +1 at 02:05:16 UTC with one non-blocking advisory. Shared artifact cd39-137e-0afd-490e persisted schema code_review_result_v2 with coverage.llm_ran=true, blocking=[], advisory=[1], dropped=[3], indeterminate=[]. The surfaced finding correctly identifies the exact severity directive as Pass-1 performing Pass-3 work, with Pass-2 validity=0.8571 and impact=0.32 and Pass-3 priority=0.2743 / decision=advisory. However, it has no reviewer_id, criteria=[correctness, regression, maintainability], and block_threshold=0.95. No surviving or dropped finding carries reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries or criteria project.review-phase-boundaries. The raw REVIEW_RESULT matches the reduced audit payload, ruling out artifact serialization loss. Because the expected project identity and project threshold 0.90 are absent, this does not satisfy the negative-probe criterion-execution AC. Bug 22f5-5a48-3ab1-463e records the seam defect. Per this story plan, the exact negative patchset is left in Gerrit, no alternate probe is improvised, and this story is blocked pending repair and an unchanged live rerun.
